metadata.question: On June 24, 2025, was New York City highest temperature higher than June 24, 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Collection: NOAA’s NCEP GDAS near-surface air temperature (or ERA5-Land as fallback). - Date: single-day 2024-06-24 vs 2025-06-24. - Location: NYC ≈ point (-74.006, 40.7128). 2. Masking: none needed (temperature band is continuous). 3. Logic: - Pull one image per date; if .size()==0 → C1. - Sample 2-m temperature at the point (mean of 0.25° pixel is fine). - If either sample is None/NaN → C3, else compare and print A/B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.006, 40.7128]) def get_temp(date_str): col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CFSV2/FOR6H') \ .filterDate(date_str, ee.Date(date_str).advance(1, 'day')) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: return None return col.first().select('Temperature_surface') \ .reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), pt, 1000) \ .get('Temperature_surface').getInfo() t24 = get_temp('2024-06-24') t25 = get_temp('2025-06-24') print(f"2024-06-24 T: {t24}") print(f"2025-06-24 T: {t25}") if t24 is None or t25 is None: print("C1") elif t24 > t25: print("B") else: print("A") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

pt = ee.Geometry.Point([-74.006, 40.7128])

def get_temp(date_str):
    col = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/CFSV2/FOR6H') \
           .filterDate(date_str, ee.Date(date_str).advance(1, 'day'))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        return None
    return col.first().select('Temperature_surface') \
             .reduceRegion(ee.Reducer.mean(), pt, 1000) \
             .get('Temperature_surface').getInfo()

t24 = get_temp('2024-06-24')
t25 = get_temp('2025-06-24')

print(f"2024-06-24 T: {t24}")
print(f"2025-06-24 T: {t25}")

if t24 is None or t25 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif t24 > t25:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
